reason: The cited lines show the tool reads the browser tab's recorded network requests, filters them, formats request URLs/lines, and returns them via response.addResult; no arbitrary host code execution is shown. It does not send data to an attacker-readable external destination; addResult returns/saves the result locally, and a suggested filename is not a network/public sink. The returned network request URLs/lines can be controlled by the loaded web page or remote sites, so UNTRUSTED is supported. Although browser network history may include sensitive/private URLs in some sessions, these lines alone do not establish that the returned data is non-public user/host/SaaS data, so SECRET is insufficient.
